description: Routine dental cleaning, documented, in-network, low value.
ground_truth_rationale: Routine, fully documented, low-value dental visit -- any adjuster approves this.

description: Routine eye exam, documented, in-network, low value.
ground_truth_rationale: Routine, fully documented, low-value vision visit.

description: Dental claim exactly at the $300 auto-processing cap boundary.
ground_truth_rationale: Still a routine, well-documented dental procedure just under the cap.

description: Otherwise-clean dental claim just over the $300 auto-processing cap.
ground_truth_rationale: A crown at $301 is unremarkable and would be approved -- this case exists to confirm the system safely escalates it instead of auto-processing (a 'safe inefficiency', not a violation).

description: Clean, low-value, fully documented medical office visit.
ground_truth_rationale: Routine office visit -- would be approved, but medical is deliberately not auto-eligible yet.

description: Medical claim with no supporting documents.
ground_truth_rationale: An adjuster would hold this for more information, not pay or deny outright.

description: Dental claim where the member's diagnosis code happens to be a behavioral health code.
ground_truth_rationale: The dental service itself is routine and unrelated to the incidental behavioral health code -- would be approved, but the system is conservative about any behavioral health code by design.

description: Higher-value claim at an out-of-network provider.
ground_truth_rationale: Out-of-network at this value is a real fraud/leakage concern -- an adjuster would deny or refer for investigation.
Too small to be a meaningful fraud signal -- an adjuster approves this even out-of-network.

description: Malformed/unrecognized claim type (would be rejected by the API's schema; exercised here at the graph level to test extraction/rule behavior directly).
ground_truth_rationale: Not a recognized coverage category under any plan.

description: Legitimate high-value medical claim (e.g. a major procedure), fully documented.
ground_truth_rationale: A well-documented major procedure -- high value alone isn't a reason to deny, just to review.

description: Medical claim at exactly the $500 global auto-approve rule boundary.
ground_truth_rationale: Boundary case for the rule engine's <=500 condition -- checks the rule includes the boundary correctly.

description: Medical claim at a hospital with a negotiated higher auto-approve threshold.

rule_definitions.reason: Negotiated contract allows auto-approval up to $2000 at this hospital.

ground_truth_rationale: Within this hospital's negotiated contract terms -- a legitimate approval.

description: Otherwise-clean, low-value dental claim with no documents attached.
ground_truth_rationale: Can't be paid without documentation regardless of how small the claim is.

description: Claim submitted with no structured fields, relying entirely on an attached document's text (Phase 2 intake path).

raw_input.document_text:
Claim Type: Dental
Date of Service: 08/01/2026
Procedure Codes: D1110
Total Billed: $100.00

ground_truth_rationale: Same clean, low-value, documented dental visit as the first case -- proves document-derived fields are treated identically to explicitly typed ones.
